RC-review-form-draft.findings: Delivery D11: Name caregiver and visit/date above the five-star review and full comment; preserve current validation/limits and separate rating from hours/payment. Retain selected stars and the entire draft when navigating or correcting errors; explicit Submit stores the review. Return to the next visit/plan after submission without ending the arrangement.

SH-navigation-menu.findings: Delivery D06: Preserve Care, Caregivers, Messages, Request care, notifications and account destinations in a consistent mobile menu; use stable request tabs and keep Support clear of fixed actions. Verify keyboard focus, current-page state and larger text.

Keep one-time date, start, duration/end, exact-address fields and all cost/privacy details.
